metadata.description: Skills for running marketing through an AI agent — one plugin per platform Plainpaper knows about.

plugins.name: plainpaper
plugins.description: Plan, write and approve marketing campaigns with Claude on a Plainpaper board: Black Friday, product launches, welcome emails, ads and more. Bundles the Plainpaper connector and four skills.

plugins.name: brevo
plugins.description: Skills for Brevo (formerly Sendinblue). Includes brevo-automation-builder, which builds a complete marketing automation from a briefing by clicking through Brevo's automation builder in Chrome and hands it back as an inactive draft.
